subject.title: Base de datos dev ligera con sandboxes desechables

question: What first supported dev-database slice should be implemented before any automated PR work starts?
rationale: The code shape is visible, but the source of truth for anonymized cohorts, retention, allowed database names, and destructive-operation confirmations is a safety policy choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Start with guarded command slice
options.body: Implement only `dev-db:audit`, `dev-db:index-sync`, `dev-db:create-sandbox`, and `dev-db:drop-sandbox` with denylisted production names, explicit confirmations, no production refresh automation, and short docs.

options.title: Scope full anonymized base refresh first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define the `Hamelyn_DEV_BASE` refresh, anonymization rules, fixture sources, and ownership process end to end.

options.title: Keep as manual runbook only
options.body: Document the current fulfillment sandbox and production guard patterns without adding shared commands yet, accepting that teams continue to create sandboxes manually.

recommendation.title: Start with guarded command slice
recommendation.body: Implement only `dev-db:audit`, `dev-db:index-sync`, `dev-db:create-sandbox`, and `dev-db:drop-sandbox` with denylisted production names, explicit confirmations, no production refresh automation, and short docs.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn introduced the closest existing sandbox helper and authored the current feature request, so they are the best available owner for scoping the first slice.
